page.meta_description_en: NE555 precision timer IC with adjustable duty cycle, TTL-compatible output (200mA), and timing from microseconds to hours. Ideal for pulse shaping, frequency division, and industrial controls. Available in SOIC, PDIP, and TSSOP packages.
page.meta_description_zh: NE555精密定时器IC，支持可调占空比，TTL兼容输出（200mA），定时范围从微秒到小时。适用于脉冲整形、频率分频和工业控制。提供SOIC、PDIP和TSSOP封装。
